short: Shop quality cannabis at our dispensary in Georgetown, where you’ll find potent vapes, locally grown flower, and so much more. Shop in-store or online.
long: Mission Dispensaries in Georgetown, MA, makes it easy to explore cannabis in a space that’s welcoming, professional, and built around you. Located at 401 East Main Street, near the historic Brocklebank–Nelson–Beecher House, our storefront proudly serves both recreational and medical customers in a setting designed for comfort and clarity. From our thoughtfully curated menu to our loyalty program and daily deals, every part of your visit is made to support informed, responsible choices. Our knowledgeable team is here to answer questions, offer guidance, and ensure a consistent, approachable experience every time. Whether you’re new to cannabis or well-versed, you’ll find trusted support at our Georgetown dispensary.
